overlap_check.method: Compared exact tuples on feasible common fields after rounding age_days/365.25 to integer years and mapping gender codes; full tuples included age, gender, blood pressure, and cholesterol.
overlap_check.mendeley_result: 0 new rows matched any Mendeley row on the full common tuple; coarse partial tuples matched because age/gender/BP values are non-unique.
overlap_check.heart5_result: No exact semantic full-tuple comparison was possible because heart5 lacks compatible cholesterol coding and uses a different schema; age/gender/BP partial overlap is non-identifying.
overlap_check.limitations: No patient-level identifiers or source linkage were available, so near-duplicate analysis cannot establish independence.
